para.text: There are basically two plotting modes:

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;

text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; text-decoration:underline; color:#000000;

para.text: : single-y mode occurs when there is only one column of Y-values (NY=1), or if all Y-axis codes are 0 (zero). In the latter case only the first Y-column (1) is plotted, the rest is ignored. In single-y mode the array is plotted using the active Y-axis and can be treated as any other plotting routine. Multiple arrays can be plotted in a single graph, but data tracking is only active on the last one.

para.style: text-align:left; text-indent:0px; margin-top:0px; margin-right:0px; margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:0px; line-height:1.00; background-color:transparent; white-space:normal; page-break-inside:auto; page-break-after:auto; border:none; tabstops:24px left ;

text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; text-decoration:underline; color:#000000;

para.text: : multiple-y mode occurs when there are more than 1 columns of Y-data and the (some) axis codes are non-zero. The axis codes (data[0,y]) are to represent the Y-axis that the data (column) are to be plotted with (range: 1-4). Each column of Y-data with an axis code in that range will be plotted with the X-value as in the first column (0), columns with a zero code will be ignored. Different columns may have equal axis codes: they are plotted using the same Y-axis. In multiple-y mode the symbol types are selected automatically, you can only set the size and fill-mode. Note that ALL Y-axes have to be plotted before calling

text.style: font-family:'Times New Roman'; font-size:12pt; text-decoration:underline; color:#000000;

para.text: Multiple-y mode enables plotting the data in different ways without redefining the whole array, simple change the axis codes.
